name: agy-link
description: Use Antigravity-hosted Claude models through a local gateway (OmniRoute, 9router): shows the gateway's Antigravity quota above the prompt and can point Claude Code at the gateway for you.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Base URL of your local gateway (OmniRoute or 9router), with no path. Default: http://localhost:20128

gateway_key.title: Gateway API key
gateway_key.description: The gateway's own API key. Used to read its usage endpoint and, with activate on, as Claude Code's credential for the gateway. Never your claude.ai or Anthropic credentials.

activate.title: Point Claude Code at the gateway
activate.description: At session start, set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the gateway key) so this session's requests go to the gateway. Off by default: with it on, every session fails while the gateway is down.

usage_url.title: Usage URL (optional)
usage_url.description: Full URL of the quota endpoint. Empty: OmniRoute's <gateway>/api/usage/om-usage?format=json. For 9router use http://localhost:20128/api/usage/<connectionId>. Any endpoint returning {"windows":[{"label","percentUsed","resetsAt"}]} works too.

family.title: Model family
family.description: Which Antigravity quota to show: claude (Claude and GPT-OSS share one), gemini, or all.

show_when.title: Show when
show_when.description: gateway: only while this session's requests go to the gateway. always: whenever the gateway answers.

poll_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to read the gateway's usage endpoint.

show_reset.title: Show reset countdowns
show_reset.description: How long until each window resets.

warn_pct.title: Warning at (%)
warn_pct.description: A window turns yellow from this percentage used.

critical_pct.title: Critical at (%)
critical_pct.description: A window turns red from this percentage used.
